title: bartlettina constipatiflora
intro: Bartlettina constipatiflora, commonly known as the "Mexican mint plant" or "Mexican mountain mint", is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. The health benefits of Bartlettina constipatiflora include its ability to reduce inflammation, treat digestive issues, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bartlettina constipatiflora include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
